name: Ubuntu
description: Most popular Linux distribution with excellent community support and regular updates.
fullDescription: Ubuntu is a free and open-source Linux distribution based on Debian. It is one of the most widely used Linux distributions for both personal computers and servers. Ubuntu comes with regular updates and a large community support.

name: Fedora
description: Cutting-edge Linux distribution sponsored by Red Hat with latest technologies.
fullDescription: Fedora is a Linux distribution developed by the community-supported Fedora Project and sponsored primarily by Red Hat. It aims to be on the cutting edge of open source technologies.

name: Debian
description: One of the oldest and most stable Linux distributions with extensive package support.
fullDescription: Debian is a free operating system for your computer. It comes with over 59,000 packages, pre-compiled software bundled up in a nice format for easy installation.

name: Linux Mint
description: Beginner-friendly Linux distribution with focus on out-of-the-box functionality.
fullDescription: Linux Mint is a community-driven Linux distribution based on Ubuntu and Debian. It provides out-of-the-box multimedia support and is designed for ease of use.

name: Arch Linux
description: Lightweight and flexible Linux distribution for experienced users.
fullDescription: Arch Linux is an independently developed Linux distribution for computers based on the x86-64 architecture. It is composed predominantly of free and open-source software.

name: CentOS
description: Stable and reliable Linux distribution for enterprise and server deployments.
fullDescription: CentOS is a Linux distribution that provides a free, community-supported computing platform functionally compatible with its upstream source Red Hat Enterprise Linux.

name: openSUSE
description: Professional-grade Linux distribution with excellent system configuration tools.
fullDescription: openSUSE is a free and Linux-based operating system for your PC, laptop or server. You can surf the web, manage your e-mails and photos, do office work, play videos or music.

name: Elementary OS
description: Beautiful and elegant Linux distribution with focus on design and user experience.
fullDescription: Elementary OS is an Ubuntu-based desktop Linux operating system. It is designed to be as fast and power-efficient as possible while maintaining the quality and reliability.

name: Kali Linux
description: Specialized Linux distribution for penetration testing and security research.
fullDescription: Kali Linux is a Debian-derived Linux distribution designed for digital forensics and penetration testing. It is maintained and funded by Offensive Security.

name: Pop!_OS
description: Fast and free operating system developed by System76 for creators and developers.
fullDescription: Pop!_OS is an operating system for STEM and creative professionals who use their computer as a tool to discover and create. Pop!_OS is an Ubuntu LTS based operating system.

name: Zorin OS
description: Elegant Linux distribution designed for Windows users transitioning to Linux.
fullDescription: Zorin OS is a desktop operating system designed to look and feel like Windows, making it simple for new users to get started with Linux. It's built on a foundation of Ubuntu.

name: Manjaro
description: User-friendly Arch Linux-based distribution with graphical installation tools.
fullDescription: Manjaro is a free and open-source Linux distribution based on the Arch Linux operating system. It provides all the benefits of Arch Linux combined with a focus on user-friendliness.

name: AlmaLinux
description: Free, open-source, production-ready Linux distribution compatible with RHEL.
fullDescription: AlmaLinux is a stable, predictable, and manageable Linux ecosystem. It benefits the open source community by providing a stable platform to build upon with long-term support.

name: Rocky Linux
description: Production-grade Linux distribution providing drop-in compatibility with RHEL.
fullDescription: Rocky Linux is a community-driven enterprise operating system designed to be 100% compatible with Red Hat Enterprise Linux. It is built by the community to be secure and stable.

name: Ubuntu Studio
description: Linux distribution optimized for audio, video, and graphics production.
fullDescription: Ubuntu Studio is a community-driven variant of Ubuntu. It is designed to be an out-of-the-box creative powerhouse with professional-grade tools pre-installed for audio production.

name: Xubuntu
description: Lightweight Ubuntu variant using the Xfce desktop environment.
fullDescription: Xubuntu is an elegant and easy to use operating system. It combines the power and flexibility of Linux with a clean, intuitive user interface. Xubuntu is based on Ubuntu.

name: Kubuntu
description: Ubuntu variant with KDE Plasma desktop environment for customizable computing.
fullDescription: Kubuntu is an operating system built by the KDE and Ubuntu communities. It uses KDE Plasma, the KDE Frameworks and other KDE technologies. It comes in flavors for desktop systems.

name: Lubuntu
description: Lightweight Ubuntu variant for older computers and low-resource systems.
fullDescription: Lubuntu is a lightweight, fast and elegant operating system with a clean and intuitive interface. It is a variant of Ubuntu using LXQt as the default desktop environment.

name: MX Linux
description: Lightweight Debian-based Linux with excellent system tools and stability.
fullDescription: MX Linux is a cooperative venture between the antiX and MX projects. It is designed to combine elegant and efficient desktops with high stability and solid performance.

name: Gentoo
description: Highly flexible and powerful Linux distribution for advanced users.
fullDescription: Gentoo is a flexible, source-based Linux distribution built for performance and customization. Every aspect of Gentoo is configurable, allowing users to create custom systems.

name: Slackware
description: One of the oldest and most stable Linux distributions emphasizing simplicity.
fullDescription: Slackware Linux is an advanced Linux operating system, designed with ease of use in mind. It aims to be the most 'UNIX-like' Linux distribution out there.

name: NixOS
description: Linux distribution with a unique declarative configuration management approach.
fullDescription: NixOS is a Linux distribution with a unique approach to package and configuration management. Built on top of the Nix package manager, NixOS is declarative and reproducible.

name: Void Linux
description: Independent Linux distribution using its own package manager and init system.
fullDescription: Void is a general purpose operating system built on top of the Linux kernel. It's a rolling release distribution and comes with the runit init system.

name: Artix Linux
description: Arch Linux-based distribution with choice of init systems instead of systemd.
fullDescription: Artix Linux is a rolling-release distribution, based on Arch Linux. It is based on the principles of simplicity and modernity. Artix Linux comes with different init systems.

name: Parrot OS
description: Security-focused Linux distribution for cybersecurity professionals and developers.
fullDescription: Parrot OS is a project based on Debian. It aims to provide a comprehensive cybersecurity environment for security professionals and developers.

name: Black Lab Linux
description: Ubuntu-based security-focused Linux for penetration testing and ethical hacking.
fullDescription: Black Lab Linux is a penetration testing, computer forensics and security operations operating system. It is built on Ubuntu and comes with pre-installed penetration testing tools.

name: Tails
description: Privacy-focused Linux designed to leave no traces and provide anonymity.
fullDescription: Tails is a portable operating system that protects your privacy and anonymity. It helps you to use the Internet anonymously and circumvent censorship almost anywhere.

name: Whonix
description: Linux distribution focused on privacy and anonymity using Tor network.
fullDescription: Whonix is a desktop operating system designed for privacy and anonymity. It is based on Debian, KVM, and VirtualBox and is routed through Tor for anonymity.

name: Qubes OS
description: Operating system focused on security through compartmentalization.
fullDescription: Qubes OS is a security-oriented operating system focused on isolation through compartmentalization. It uses virtualization to create isolated compartments.

name: Linux from Scratch
description: Educational Linux project for building your own Linux system from source.
fullDescription: Linux from Scratch (LFS) is a project that provides you with step-by-step instructions for building your own Linux system entirely from source code.

name: Tiny Core Linux
description: Minimal Linux distribution at about 15MB in size for embedded systems.
fullDescription: Tiny Core Linux is an independent minimal Linux distribution focused on providing a base system of core tools in as little disk space as possible.

name: Puppy Linux
description: Lightweight Linux for older computers with minimal resources required.
fullDescription: Puppy Linux is an operating system designed to make old computers useful again by combining small size with reasonable speed and functionality.

name: Raspberry Pi OS
description: Official operating system for Raspberry Pi microcomputers and SBCs.
fullDescription: Raspberry Pi OS is the official operating system for Raspberry Pi single-board computers. It is a Debian-based Linux optimized for the Raspberry Pi platform.

name: TrueNAS Core
description: Free and open-source NAS operating system based on FreeBSD.
fullDescription: TrueNAS Core is a free and open source operating system for network attached storage systems. It provides advanced features for data sharing across a network.

name: Proxmox VE
description: Open-source virtualization platform for management of KVM and containers.
fullDescription: Proxmox Virtual Environment (Proxmox VE) is an open-source virtualization platform for running virtual machines and containers. It is based on Debian Linux.

name: Ubuntu Server
description: Server distribution of Ubuntu optimized for data centers and cloud.
fullDescription: Ubuntu Server is a server operating system built on Ubuntu, designed to run on physical servers, virtual machines, and cloud platforms.

name: RHEL
description: Enterprise-grade Linux distribution for mission-critical systems.
fullDescription: Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) is a commercial Linux distribution offered by Red Hat. It is designed for enterprise servers, workstations, and supercomputers.

name: SUSE Linux
description: Commercial enterprise Linux distribution with professional support.
fullDescription: SUSE Linux Enterprise Server is a commercial enterprise Linux distribution based on openSUSE. It offers enterprise-grade features and professional support.

name: Deepin
description: Beautiful and user-friendly Linux distribution with elegant design from China.
fullDescription: Deepin is a Linux distribution based on Debian that emphasizes beauty, ease of use, and reliability. It features a unique and elegant desktop environment designed for everyday users.

name: Solus
description: Independent Linux distribution focusing on speed, stability and user experience.
fullDescription: Solus is an independent desktop operating system that is built from the ground up. It is designed to be a modern, capable and elegant operating system.

name: antiX Linux
description: Fast, lightweight Linux distribution for old and new computers.
fullDescription: antiX is a fast, lightweight and easy to install systemd-free Linux distribution based on Debian GNU/Linux stable for both new and old computers.
